desc: Prove the backward-crossing cut characterization of strong connectivity.
Characterize bad cut events, event compression, and the exact inclusion-exclusion chain formula.
Validate the quadratic reference DP on all public samples.
Implement a near-\(O(N\log^2N)\) CDQ/NTT acceleration of the factorial-convolution recurrence.
Pass all 3 public sample tests with the current implementation.
Exhaustively validate the implementation and recurrence on small balanced strings; prove event construction, CDQ dependency ordering, and final formula match the combinatorial count.
Verify worst-case Python time and memory behavior at \(N=2\times10^5\), including NTT allocation overhead.
